_meta.purpose: Checkov rule ID -> NIST 800-53 Rev 5 control mapping. Feeds the --compliance 800-53 control-coverage report (SPEC 5.3 / 7.2).
_meta.governance: STATIC, CHECKED-IN, HUMAN-REVIEWED DATA. The model NEVER generates a control ID at runtime. Every nist_800_53 ID is attested by an authority (infrabot cmmc_level2_aws.json, which lists the control for the concept the rule assesses) OR is source='curated' with a written rationale. A rule with no authority-backed control is coverage='unmapped' with NO controls -- never guessed, never defaulted. Silence is safer than a guess. A hallucinated AC-17 in a FedRAMP package is the single worst thing this plugin could do (risk #3).
_meta.overMappingNote: Both authorities (cmmc requirement bundles; Prowler's native nist_800_53_revision_5_aws.json) attach 20-30 controls to one check -- a public S3 check pulls in AC-17 remote-access enhancements, SC-7 boundary enhancements, etc. That maximal-recall mapping is the FedRAMP hazard. This file is hand-pruned to the DIRECT technical base control(s) each rule assesses; broad process controls (AC-17, AC-2 account-mgmt, IR-*, CM-8 inventory) are dropped even when the bundle lists them. Every such judgment is stated in the rationale for GATE 3 scrutiny.

sources.cmmc-derived: Control base-ID is attested by infrabot cmmc_level2_aws.json for the requirement bundle containing this rule's matched Prowler check; the specific base control was hand-selected as the direct technical control and coarse process controls were pruned.
sources.prowler: Prowler check metadata (concept-matched in rule-severity.json). Not used as a NIST authority here because Prowler's native 800-53 file is maximally over-mapped.
sources.curated: Human judgment where no authority cleanly covers the concept. SCRUTINIZE HARDEST. None are emitted in this build -- uncertain concepts are left unmapped instead.

_meta.checkovToProwler: The rule->concept assignment reuses WS-3's human-reviewed Checkov->Prowler concept matches recorded in rule-severity.json.

gate3.note: Signed off (GATE 3) by John P. Sasser on 2026-09-30. Curated on 2026-07-14.

_meta.regrade2026-10-06: Checkov 3.2.500 -> 3.3.25 adds CKV_AWS_393 and CKV_AWS_394. Neither concept (GitHub Actions OIDC trust conditions; aws_availability_zones pinning) appears in either authority (infrabot cmmc_level2_aws.json / prowler-cmmc map Prowler check names, and no Prowler check covers these IaC-structure rules), so both are coverage='unmapped' with NO controls. Pending GATE 3 review; nothing signed off on 2026-09-30 changed.
